args.summary: The v2.3.1 release of checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback, the service is healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: v2.3.1 of checkout-api was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Release history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rollback**: Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0. Post-rollback, the service is healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
3. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident INC-0002 describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the current healthy state. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown — it should be investigated before attempting any redeploy of that version.
